hook: Their sailboat was half sunk with an 8-year-old aboard.
narration: Their sailboat was half underwater off the Bahamas, and an eight year old was aboard.
The family had made it into a life raft, near Plana Cays.
Around midnight, a good Samaritan called the Coast Guard to report them in distress.
A Jayhawk crew from Air Station Clearwater flew out and located the family aboard the raft.
The basket comes down on the cable, and the hoist operator guides it in by hand from the open door.
One at a time, the child and both adults rode it up into the helicopter.
outcome: All three reached Bahamian authorities in Great Inagua, and no injuries were reported.
title: Half-sunk sailboat, 8-year-old aboard
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater aircrew rescued an 8-year-old child and two adults from a life raft after their sailboat became partially submerged near Plana Cays, Bahamas, on June 30, 2025.
